description: This Java source file implements a custom StatsCounter for Caffeine cache, integrating with Eclipse Ditto metrics system. It defines a class MetricsStatsCounter that tracks various cache statistics such as hits, misses, load times, evictions, and invalidations, and provides methods for recording and snapshotting these metrics.

classes.name: MetricsStatsCounter
classes.description: A Caffeine StatsCounter implementation that reports cache metrics via Eclipse Ditto metrics system. It tracks cache hits, misses, load successes & failures, evictions, and cache size estimates, enabling detailed cache performance monitoring.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new MetricsStatsCounter instance for a specific cache, with suppliers for max size and estimated size.

methods.name: recordLoadSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful load, its time, and updates cache size metrics.

methods.name: recordLoadFailure
methods.description: Records a failed load and its time.

methods.name: recordEviction
methods.description: Records an eviction and updates cache size metrics.

methods.name: recordEviction
methods.description: Records an eviction with specified weight and updates cache size metrics.

methods.name: recordInvalidationWithoutItem
methods.description: Records an invalidation that did not remove an item from cache.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current cache statistics as CacheStats object.
